inputs.name: playbook
inputs.value:
`---
- name: "Stage 1: Patch Canary Machines"
  hosts: canary
  gather_facts: yes
  become: true
  
  vars:
    patch_data: ${JSON.stringify($patchesToApply)}
  
  tasks:
    - name: Print the current host
      debug:
        msg: "Running on host: {{ inventory_hostname }}"
        
    - name: Get advisories for this host
      set_fact:
        current_host_advisories: "{{ patch_data[inventory_hostname] | default([]) }}"
        
    - name: Print advisories for this host
      debug:
        msg: "Advisories for this host: {{ current_host_advisories }}"

    - block:
        - name: Gather list of advisories BEFORE update
          command: dnf updateinfo list available
          register: advisories_before
          changed_when: false
          become: true

        - name: Apply patches if available for this host
          command: "dnf update -y --advisory={{ item }}"
          loop: "{{ current_host_advisories }}"
          register: patch_output
          when: current_host_advisories | length > 0
          become: yes
        
        - name: Restart the services that load the patched packages (this copy does not reboot the host)
          service:
            name: "{{ item }}"
            state: restarted
          loop: [php-fpm, httpd]
          when: patch_output is changed
          become: yes

        - name: Gather list of advisories AFTER update
          command: dnf updateinfo list available
          register: advisories_after
          changed_when: false
          become: true

        - name: Determine advisories that were applied from input list (no duplicates)
          set_fact:
            applied_advisories: >-
              {{
                advisories_before.stdout_lines
                | difference(advisories_after.stdout_lines)
                | map('regex_search', '^(RH[A-Z]+-[0-9]+:[0-9]+)')
                | select('string')
                | list
                | select('in', current_host_advisories)
                | unique
              }}

        - name: Record applied advisories
          set_fact:
            patch_status:
              status: "success"
              applied_advisories: "{{ applied_advisories }}"
    
      rescue:
      - name: Set patch status on failure
        set_fact:
          patch_status:
            status: "failed"
            reason: "{{ ansible_failed_result.msg | default('Unknown error') }}"
            applied_advisories: []

- name: "Generate Patch Summary Report"
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: no
  vars:
    skipped_hosts: ${JSON.stringify($skipped_hosts)}
  tasks:
    - name: Generate patch summary dictionary
      set_fact:
        patch_summary: >-
          {{
            dict(
              hostvars
              | dict2items
              | rejectattr('key', 'in', skipped_hosts)
              | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
              | map(attribute='key')
              | zip(
                  hostvars
                  | dict2items
                  | rejectattr('key', 'in', skipped_hosts)
                  | selectattr('value.patch_status', 'defined')
                  | map(attribute='value.patch_status')
                )
            )
          }}
    
    - name: Print patch summary
      debug:
        var: patch_summary
  
`

meta.description: This workflow automates the application of RHSA patches to Red Hat VMs. From the input_json, it  applies relevant advisory patches via Ansible to all the required machines, and reboots the machines as needed. MODIFIED COPY for the php-portal demo: restarts php-fpm and httpd instead of rebooting the host (the demo VM is a shared bastion).
